change: Use bounded working surfaces for cached, unstyled normal-blend raster and unclipped fill-only paint layers when occupied area is under 75% of the working viewport. Opacity is applied once by the parent compositor.
limitations: Brush, Clone, clipped strokes, masks, styles and backdrop-dependent blends retain their existing working geometry.
A general brush implementation failed exact clipped-stroke pixel parity and was restricted before retention.
64-layer operations still exceed the target; two 52–53ms tasks remain in the measured run.
